senses.en: by a large amount or to a large degree

ex.en: Our new flat is considerably warmer than the old one.
Improved public transport could considerably reduce traffic congestion and air pollution in major cities.

tip: Thường bổ nghĩa cho so sánh hơn hoặc động từ chỉ thay đổi, diễn tả sự khác biệt hoặc thay đổi lớn.

senses.en: the activity of writing down important information while listening or reading

ex.en: Note-taking helps me remember what happens during meetings.
Effective note-taking allows students to identify key arguments and review complex material more efficiently after lectures.

tip: Thường không đếm được; cụm động từ là take notes.

senses.zh: dân chủ; chế độ dân chủ
senses.en: A system of government in which people choose their leaders.
A country governed through representatives elected by its people.

ex.en: Our teacher explained democracy through a classroom vote.
A healthy democracy depends on informed citizens who can access reliable information and participate freely in public debate.

col: strengthen democracy｜củng cố thể chế dân chủ
tip: Khi chỉ chế độ thì thường không đếm được; khi chỉ một quốc gia dân chủ thì đếm được.

senses.zh: sự hỗn loạn; tình trạng vô trật tự
senses.en: a state of complete confusion and lack of order

ex.en: The kitchen was in chaos after we baked together.
Unexpected road closures caused chaos across the city, highlighting the need for better emergency planning.

tip: Danh từ không đếm được; ch phát âm /k/, không phải /tʃ/.

senses.en: an object that attracts iron and certain other metals

senses.zh: người hoặc vật có sức hút
senses.en: a person or thing that strongly attracts people or attention

ex.en: A small magnet holds our shopping list on the fridge.
Well-funded universities can act as a magnet for talented researchers, supporting innovation across the wider economy.

col: fridge magnet｜nam châm dán tủ lạnh
a magnet for tourists｜nơi thu hút du khách
tip: Nghĩa bóng chỉ sức hút với một nhóm người thường dùng a magnet for.

senses.en: a pile of things arranged on top of each other
to arrange things in a pile
a large amount of something

ex.en: A stack of clean plates stood beside the sink.
Libraries increasingly store stacks of older journals off site to create more space for collaborative learning.

col: a stack of books｜một chồng sách
tip: stacks of nghĩa là “rất nhiều”, dùng không trang trọng.

senses.zh: phức tạp tinh vi; tiên tiến
senses.en: highly developed and involving complex methods or technology

senses.zh: từng trải; có gu tinh tế
senses.en: knowledgeable about culture and confident in social situations

ex.en: This sophisticated camera adjusts its settings automatically in low light.
Sophisticated monitoring systems allow researchers to detect small changes in air quality across densely populated cities.

col: sophisticated analysis｜phân tích tinh tế và sâu sắc
tip: Tả thiết bị thì là tinh vi, tiên tiến; tả người có thể là từng trải.

senses.zh: thuộc thảo mộc; làm từ thảo mộc
senses.en: Relating to herbs or made from them.

ex.en: I usually drink herbal tea before going to bed.
Although herbal remedies are widely used, their safety and effectiveness should be assessed through reliable scientific research.

tip: Anh-Anh đọc âm h, Anh-Mỹ thường không đọc h.

senses.zh: người thuê nhà; người thuê đất
senses.en: someone who pays rent to use property or land

ex.en: The new tenant brought plants for the balcony.
Clear rental agreements protect both the tenant and the landlord by defining their responsibilities.

col: prospective tenant｜người có ý định thuê
tenant rights｜quyền của người thuê nhà
tip: tenant là người thuê, landlord là chủ nhà; hai vai trò tương ứng nhau.

senses.en: Done by hand or operated by a person, not automatically.
Involving physical work rather than mainly mental work.
A book giving instructions for using or doing something.

ex.en: This manual coffee grinder takes some effort to turn.
Although automation increases productivity, many industries still rely on manual labour for complex tasks.

col: user manual｜sách hướng dẫn người dùng
tip: Làm tính từ chỉ thủ công hoặc chân tay; làm danh từ chỉ sách hướng dẫn.

senses.zh: kiến thức chuyên môn; kỹ năng chuyên sâu
senses.en: Specialist knowledge or skills gained through training and experience.

ex.en: We need your expertise to repair this old clock.
Universities can support local businesses by sharing their expertise in renewable energy and sustainable manufacturing.

col: expertise in｜chuyên môn trong lĩnh vực nào đó
draw on expertise｜tận dụng chuyên môn
tip: Không đếm được; chuyên môn trong lĩnh vực nào dùng expertise in.

senses.zh: cạnh tranh gay gắt; mang tính cạnh tranh
senses.en: Involving people or organisations trying to outperform each other.
Strongly wanting to win or be better than others.
As good as or better than what others offer.

ex.en: Our weekend football league has become surprisingly competitive.
In a competitive job market, graduates need practical experience as well as strong academic qualifications.

col: a competitive market｜thị trường cạnh tranh gay gắt
a competitive advantage｜lợi thế cạnh tranh
highly competitive｜cạnh tranh rất khốc liệt
tip: Tả người thường là hiếu thắng; tả giá cả là có tính cạnh tranh.

senses.en: The highest point of a mountain.
A meeting between national leaders or other senior officials.

ex.en: We reached the snowy summit just before sunrise.
At the climate summit, national leaders discussed practical measures to reduce emissions and support vulnerable communities.

col: reach the summit｜lên đến đỉnh núi
a climate summit｜hội nghị thượng đỉnh về khí hậu
hold a summit｜tổ chức hội nghị thượng đỉnh
tip: Đỉnh núi thường dùng the summit of; hội nghị thượng đỉnh dùng a summit.

senses.zh: tinh thần; ý chí; khí phách
senses.en: Inner strength, courage, or enthusiasm
A person's soul or a being without a physical body
A strong alcoholic drink made by distillation

ex.en: Even after losing, our team showed great spirit.
Community projects can strengthen a spirit of cooperation and encourage residents to take pride in their neighbourhoods.

col: in good spirits｜tâm trạng phấn chấn
a spirit of cooperation｜tinh thần hợp tác
tip: Khi nghĩa là “tâm trạng” hoặc chỉ rượu mạnh nói chung, thường dùng số nhiều spirits.

senses.en: a large amount of money and valuable possessions

senses.zh: số lượng lớn; sự phong phú
senses.en: a large supply of something useful or valuable

ex.en: His wealth allowed him to buy a spacious house.
A fairer distribution of wealth could improve access to education and reduce inequality across society.

col: distribution of wealth｜phân phối của cải
a wealth of experience｜kinh nghiệm phong phú
tip: wealth thường không đếm được; a wealth of nghĩa là rất nhiều thứ có giá trị.

senses.zh: sự giảm; sự hạ thấp; sự thu nhỏ
senses.en: a decrease in the amount, size, or level of something

ex.en: The shop offered a generous reduction on winter coats.
A substantial reduction in food waste could lower household costs and reduce pressure on landfill sites.

col: a reduction in costs｜giảm chi phí
tip: reduction in đi với đối tượng bị giảm, of có thể đi với mức giảm.

senses.en: To differ or change depending on circumstances.
To change something or introduce different kinds.

ex.en: Bus fares vary depending on how far you travel.
Access to affordable housing can vary considerably between regions, affecting where young professionals choose to live.

col: vary from place to place｜khác nhau tùy nơi
vary your diet｜làm đa dạng chế độ ăn
tip: vary from A to B chỉ phạm vi; vary in chỉ khác nhau ở một mặt nào đó.

senses.en: Happening halfway through an academic term or period in office.
An examination taken halfway through an academic term.

ex.en: Our mid-term exams start after the spring holiday.
Mid-term assessments can help teachers identify learning difficulties before students take their final examinations.

tip: Cũng thường viết midterm; làm danh từ chỉ kỳ thi giữa kỳ, phổ biến trong Anh-Mỹ.

senses.en: Something you must do for legal or moral reasons

ex.en: You have no obligation to buy anything here.
Employers have a legal obligation to provide safe working conditions and protect employees from preventable harm.

col: fulfil an obligation｜thực hiện nghĩa vụ
under no obligation｜không có nghĩa vụ
tip: Thường dùng have an obligation to do, nghĩa là có nghĩa vụ làm gì.

senses.en: To think of someone or something in a particular way.

senses.zh: sự tôn trọng; sự quan tâm
senses.en: Respect for someone or attention to something.
Friendly greetings sent to someone, expressed in the plural.

ex.en: I regard this little café as my second home.
Policymakers increasingly regard access to reliable internet services as essential for equal participation in modern education.

col: send my regards｜gửi lời hỏi thăm của tôi
tip: “Coi A là B” dùng regard A as B, không dùng to be.

senses.en: Small amounts of water in the air or a material

ex.en: Keep the lid on so the rice retains its moisture.
Planting ground cover helps soil retain moisture and reduces the need for irrigation in dry regions.

tip: Không đếm được; moisture là độ ẩm, không phải lượng mưa.

senses.zh: hay thay đổi; có thể thay đổi
senses.en: Likely or able to change rather than remain the same.

senses.zh: biến số; yếu tố thay đổi
senses.en: A quantity or factor that can take different values.

ex.en: The weather here is too variable for outdoor plans.
Researchers must control other variables when investigating how class size affects students' progress in primary education.

tip: Làm tính từ chỉ có thể thay đổi; làm danh từ đếm được chỉ biến số.

senses.en: A numerical fact obtained by collecting and examining information.

ex.en: That surprising statistic made us check the survey again.
A single statistic rarely captures the full impact of unemployment on families and their communities.

col: revealing statistic｜số liệu thống kê nói lên vấn đề
alarming statistic｜số liệu thống kê đáng lo ngại
official statistics｜số liệu thống kê chính thức
tip: Statistics chỉ số liệu thì động từ chia số nhiều; chỉ ngành thống kê thì chia số ít.

senses.en: showing care for other people's needs and feelings
thinking carefully, or showing careful consideration

ex.en: It was thoughtful of you to bring an umbrella.
Thoughtful urban planning can create public spaces that meet the needs of residents with limited mobility.

col: thoughtful of someone｜ai đó rất chu đáo
tip: Chu đáo dùng thoughtful of someone; thoughtful không nhất thiết có nghĩa lo lắng.

senses.en: To make someone feel extremely frightened.

ex.en: Sudden thunder can terrify our dog during summer storms.
Extreme weather events can terrify young children, making clear explanations and reassurance from adults especially important.

col: terrify someone｜làm ai đó vô cùng sợ hãi
be terrified by｜bị ... dọa cho khiếp vía
tip: Ngoại động từ; terrified tả người, terrifying tả điều đáng sợ.

senses.en: The sea between southern Europe, northern Africa, and western Asia.
Relating to the Mediterranean Sea or the countries around it.

ex.en: We sailed across the Mediterranean on a small boat.
The Mediterranean region faces increasing water shortages as rising temperatures place pressure on agriculture and tourism.

col: Mediterranean climate｜khí hậu Địa Trung Hải
Mediterranean diet｜chế độ ăn Địa Trung Hải
tip: Khi chỉ vùng biển thường dùng the Mediterranean, viết hoa chữ cái đầu.

senses.en: A word part added at the beginning to change meaning.

ex.en: Adding the prefix un turns happy into its opposite.
Learning common prefixes can help students infer the meanings of unfamiliar words when reading academic texts.

tip: prefix đứng đầu từ, suffix đứng cuối từ; cả hai gọi chung là affix.

senses.en: the chance that something will happen

ex.en: Dark clouds increased the likelihood of rain this afternoon.
Regular physical activity can reduce the likelihood of developing certain health conditions later in life.

col: in all likelihood｜rất có khả năng
tip: Thường dùng likelihood of doing hoặc likelihood that + mệnh đề.

senses.en: To transmit programmes through radio, television, or the internet.

senses.zh: chương trình phát sóng; buổi phát sóng
senses.en: A programme transmitted through radio, television, or the internet.

ex.en: The station broadcasts local news every morning before breakfast.
Public television should broadcast educational programmes that help children understand science and develop an interest in learning.

col: broadcast a programme｜phát một chương trình
tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ thường đều là broadcast.

senses.en: very informal words used by particular groups of people

ex.en: My younger cousin uses slang I cannot understand.
Although slang can strengthen group identity, excessive use may create barriers between speakers from different generations.

tip: Thường không đếm được; một cách nói lóng là a slang term.

senses.en: To get something, especially through effort or a formal process.

ex.en: You can obtain a replacement key from the landlord.
Researchers must obtain informed consent from participants before collecting personal data for a scientific study.

col: obtain a qualification｜đạt được trình độ
obtain consent｜có được sự đồng ý
tip: Trang trọng hơn get; thường dùng obtain sth from sb hoặc từ một cơ quan.

senses.en: A substance released into the environment, especially a polluting gas.

senses.zh: sự phát ra; sự thải ra
senses.en: The process of releasing gas, heat, light, or other energy.

ex.en: The mechanic checked my car's emissions this morning.
Governments can reduce carbon emissions by investing in renewable energy and improving public transport networks.

tip: Khi chỉ khí thải hoặc lượng phát thải thường dùng số nhiều emissions; động từ là emit.

senses.en: Extremely good and much better than average.

senses.zh: chưa xử lý; chưa thanh toán
senses.en: Not yet completed, settled, or paid.

ex.en: The young pianist gave an outstanding performance last night.
Universities should recognise outstanding teaching as well as research when deciding which staff members to promote.

col: outstanding performance｜màn trình diễn xuất sắc
outstanding issues｜vấn đề chưa giải quyết
tip: outstanding debt là khoản nợ chưa trả, không phải “khoản nợ xuất sắc”.

senses.en: morally very bad and deliberately causing harm

senses.zh: điều ác; tội ác; tai họa
senses.en: serious moral wrongdoing or something that causes great harm

ex.en: In the story, an evil wizard steals everyone's dreams.
Literature often explores the conflict between good and evil through characters who face difficult moral choices.

col: an evil intention｜ý đồ xấu xa
a necessary evil｜điều xấu bất đắc dĩ phải chấp nhận
tip: Mạnh hơn bad nhiều, thường liên quan đến điều sai trái nghiêm trọng về đạo đức.

senses.en: A card game involving bets on the strength of players' hands.
A metal rod used to move fuel in a fire.

ex.en: We played poker with plastic counters after dinner.
Researchers study poker to understand how people make decisions when information is incomplete and outcomes are uncertain.

col: a fireplace poker｜que cời lửa lò sưởi
tip: poker là một trò chơi bài cụ thể, không chỉ mọi trò bài.

senses.zh: tự tử; hành vi tự sát
senses.en: The act of intentionally causing one's own death.

ex.en: Our local centre offers free workshops on suicide prevention.
Suicide prevention requires accessible mental health services, supportive communities, and responsible reporting in the media.

col: die by suicide｜chết do tự tử
tip: Cách nói trung tính thường dùng die by suicide để tránh kỳ thị.

senses.zh: cuộc điều tra; sự tìm hiểu
senses.en: a careful effort to discover facts about an event or problem

senses.zh: sự nghiên cứu; sự khảo sát
senses.en: a systematic study intended to increase knowledge about a subject

ex.en: An investigation revealed why the kitchen ceiling was leaking.
An independent investigation into river pollution could help authorities identify its causes and prevent further environmental damage.

col: conduct an investigation｜tiến hành điều tra
launch an investigation｜mở cuộc điều tra
an investigation into｜cuộc điều tra về
tip: Điều tra về việc gì dùng investigation into; under investigation nghĩa là đang bị điều tra.

senses.en: pleasant and enjoyable
willing to accept or agree to something

ex.en: We spent an agreeable afternoon chatting in the garden.
Employees may be more agreeable to organisational changes when managers explain the benefits and address their concerns.

col: agreeable company｜người bầu bạn dễ chịu
agreeable to a proposal｜tán thành một đề xuất
tip: be agreeable to sth nghĩa là sẵn lòng chấp nhận điều gì, khá trang trọng.

senses.en: A reference work containing information about many subjects or one field

ex.en: We found a dinosaur picture in the encyclopaedia.
An online encyclopaedia provides a useful starting point for research, but students should verify information using reliable sources.

col: online encyclopaedia｜bách khoa toàn thư trực tuyến
an encyclopaedia entry｜một mục từ bách khoa
consult an encyclopaedia｜tra cứu bách khoa toàn thư
tip: Cách viết Anh-Anh; Anh-Mỹ thường viết encyclopedia.

senses.zh: diễn đạt lại bằng lời của mình
senses.en: Express the same meaning using different words.

senses.zh: bản diễn đạt lại; diễn giải
senses.en: A version expressing the same meaning in different words.

ex.en: Could you paraphrase that explanation so I can understand?
Students should learn to paraphrase sources accurately while acknowledging the original authors in their academic writing.

col: paraphrase a passage｜diễn đạt lại một đoạn văn
accurate paraphrase｜diễn đạt lại chính xác
paraphrase in your own words｜diễn đạt lại bằng lời của mình
tip: Diễn đạt lại phải giữ nguyên nghĩa; summarize thiên về tóm tắt ý chính.

senses.en: A partnership between groups or countries pursuing shared goals.

ex.en: The two clubs formed an alliance to save the pool.
An international alliance can help countries coordinate their responses to environmental threats that cross national borders.

tip: Thường dùng form an alliance with, nghĩa là liên minh với ai.

senses.en: The study of relationships between living things and their environment.

senses.zh: hệ sinh thái; mối quan hệ sinh thái
senses.en: The relationships between living things and their environment.

ex.en: My sister studies ecology and often visits local wetlands.
Understanding forest ecology can help governments protect wildlife while managing natural resources more effectively.

col: study ecology｜nghiên cứu sinh thái học
tip: ecology chỉ sinh thái học hoặc mối quan hệ sinh thái, không đồng nghĩa với environment.

senses.zh: vây cá; bộ phận hình vây
senses.en: a flat body part or structure aiding movement or stability
a flat rubber covering worn on a foot for swimming

ex.en: We spotted a shark's fin just above the water.
Changes in fin shape can affect how efficiently fish move through different aquatic environments.

col: tail fin｜vây đuôi; đuôi máy bay
tip: Khi chỉ chân vịt lặn thường dùng số nhiều fins.

senses.zh: thuộc bưu chính; qua đường bưu điện
senses.en: Relating to the system of collecting and delivering mail.

ex.en: The postal worker left a parcel by our door.
Reliable postal services remain essential for rural communities where internet access is limited or unavailable.

col: a postal worker｜nhân viên bưu điện
a postal address｜địa chỉ gửi thư
tip: postal là tính từ; cước phí gửi thư dùng danh từ postage.

senses.zh: sang một bên; ở bên cạnh
senses.en: to or at one side, away from the main position
away from current consideration or use

senses.zh: lời nói bên lề; lời thì thầm; chuyện ngoài lề
senses.en: a quiet remark or comment outside the main conversation

ex.en: She stepped aside to let the cyclist pass.
Governments should set aside sufficient funds for maintaining public parks, rather than focusing solely on new construction.

col: put differences aside｜tạm gác bất đồng
tip: aside thường là trạng từ; “ngoài ... ra” dùng aside from.

senses.zh: không thỏa đáng; không đạt yêu cầu
senses.en: Not good enough to meet expectations or requirements.

ex.en: The repair was unsatisfactory, so I called the mechanic again.
Unsatisfactory housing conditions can negatively affect children's health and their ability to concentrate at school.

col: unsatisfactory results｜kết quả không như mong muốn
unsatisfactory performance｜màn thể hiện không đạt
tip: Tả sự việc chưa đủ tốt; sự không hài lòng của người dùng dissatisfied.

senses.zh: trang bị; cung cấp thiết bị
senses.en: To provide someone or something with necessary tools or equipment

senses.zh: trang bị kiến thức hoặc năng lực
senses.en: To give someone the skills or knowledge they need

ex.en: We equipped our bikes with lights before riding home.
Schools should equip students with practical financial skills so they can manage their money confidently as adults.

col: equip something with｜trang bị cho vật gì
equip students with skills｜trang bị kỹ năng cho học sinh
fully equipped kitchen｜căn bếp đầy đủ thiết bị
tip: Thường dùng equip A with B; quá khứ equipped gấp đôi chữ p.

senses.en: a poor urban area with overcrowded housing in bad condition

ex.en: Their family shared a small room in a crowded slum.
Improving sanitation and access to clean water can significantly reduce disease in densely populated slums.

col: slum housing｜nhà ở khu ổ chuột
slum residents｜cư dân khu ổ chuột
slum clearance｜giải tỏa khu ổ chuột
tip: Chỉ khu đô thị có điều kiện sống tồi tàn, không đồng nghĩa với mọi khu thu nhập thấp.

senses.en: No longer useful or suitable because things have changed.

ex.en: This outdated map doesn't show the new train station.
Hospitals need adequate funding to replace outdated equipment and provide safer, more effective treatment for patients.

tip: Nhấn mạnh không còn phù hợp do thời đại thay đổi, không chỉ là đã lâu đời.

senses.en: a flower or mass of flowers on a tree or bush
to produce flowers
to develop successfully or become more confident

ex.en: Pink blossom covered the cherry tree outside our kitchen.
Creative talent can blossom when schools provide supportive teaching and regular opportunities for artistic expression.

tip: Thường chỉ hoa của cây; blossom into có thể dùng nghĩa bóng là trưởng thành thành.

senses.zh: đầy tham vọng; có hoài bão
senses.en: strongly wanting to achieve success
requiring considerable effort or resources to succeed

ex.en: My ambitious sister hopes to run her own bakery.
The city has announced an ambitious plan to replace all diesel buses with electric vehicles within a decade.

col: ambitious goals｜mục tiêu đầy tham vọng
ambitious plan｜kế hoạch đầy tham vọng
ambitious young people｜thanh niên có hoài bão
tip: Tả người là có hoài bão; tả kế hoạch nhấn mạnh mục tiêu lớn, độ khó cao.

senses.en: to do what a duty, promise, or agreement requires
to provide what is needed or meet a requirement
to achieve something hoped for or develop an ability fully

ex.en: She fulfilled her promise and repaired my bicycle.
Public libraries fulfil an important social role by providing free access to information and learning resources.

col: fulfil a promise｜thực hiện lời hứa
fulfil your potential｜phát huy hết tiềm năng
fulfil a dream｜thực hiện ước mơ
tip: Anh-Anh viết fulfil, Anh-Mỹ viết fulfill; quá khứ đều là fulfilled.

senses.zh: chuyên gia; bác sĩ chuyên khoa
senses.en: Someone with detailed knowledge or training in a particular field.
Connected with a particular field requiring special knowledge.

ex.en: My doctor sent me to a skin specialist.
Schools should employ a specialist to support children who have difficulties with language development.

col: a specialist in｜chuyên gia trong lĩnh vực
see a specialist｜đi khám bác sĩ chuyên khoa
tip: Danh từ đi với in để chỉ lĩnh vực chuyên môn; tính từ thường bổ nghĩa cho knowledge.

senses.en: Causing someone's death.

senses.zh: có tính hủy diệt; dẫn đến thất bại
senses.en: Causing something to fail completely.

ex.en: These wild mushrooms can be fatal if you eat them.
Lower speed limits near schools can reduce the risk of fatal accidents involving pedestrians and cyclists.

col: prove fatal｜cuối cùng gây tử vong
tip: fatal nhấn mạnh gây chết người hoặc dẫn đến thất bại; fateful chỉ điều có ảnh hưởng quyết định.

senses.en: A person who writes novels.

ex.en: The novelist spends every morning writing at her kitchen table.
A skilled novelist can reveal social inequalities through characters whose experiences differ greatly from those of readers.

col: historical novelist｜tiểu thuyết gia lịch sử
bestselling novelist｜tiểu thuyết gia ăn khách
aspiring novelist｜người muốn trở thành tiểu thuyết gia
tip: novelist thường chỉ người viết tiểu thuyết dài; novel là tiểu thuyết.

senses.en: Ancient remains or traces of living things preserved in rock.

ex.en: We found a tiny shell fossil inside the rock.
Fossil evidence helps scientists understand how animals adapted to environmental changes over millions of years.

tip: fossil fuels là các nhiên liệu hóa thạch như than, dầu mỏ, khí đốt.

senses.en: The ability to see

ex.en: My grandfather still has excellent eyesight without wearing glasses.
Regular eye examinations can identify conditions that may damage eyesight if they are left untreated.

col: damage your eyesight｜làm hại thị lực
tip: eyesight là danh từ không đếm được, không nói an eyesight.

senses.en: a fault that makes something imperfect or less effective
to damage something or make it imperfect

ex.en: I noticed a tiny flaw in the glass bowl.
A major flaw in the research design makes its conclusions about student performance less reliable.

col: a fundamental flaw｜khuyết điểm cơ bản
a fatal flaw｜khuyết điểm chí mạng
a flaw in the argument｜lỗ hổng trong lập luận
tip: Danh từ đếm được; khuyết điểm của vật gì thường dùng a flaw in sth.

senses.en: Not paid, returned, or completed by the expected time.

senses.zh: đáng lẽ phải có từ lâu
senses.en: Needed or deserved much earlier than now.

ex.en: I found an overdue library book under my bed.
Investment in rural public transport is long overdue, as many residents still lack reliable services.

col: an overdue payment｜khoản tiền quá hạn
an overdue library book｜sách thư viện quá hạn chưa trả
tip: long overdue nhấn mạnh “lẽ ra phải có từ lâu”, không chỉ là muộn.

senses.en: formally tell someone to do something
teach someone a skill or explain how to do something

ex.en: The guide instructed us to stay on the path.
Schools should instruct students in basic first aid so they can respond safely during emergencies.

col: instruct someone to do something｜chỉ thị cho ai làm gì
instruct someone in something｜dạy ai về
instruct staff｜đưa ra chỉ thị cho nhân viên
tip: instruct sb to do là chỉ thị; instruct sb in là dạy.

senses.en: Relating to cities or towns rather than the countryside.

ex.en: Our urban garden sits between two tall apartment buildings.
Rapid urban growth can increase pressure on public transport, housing, and essential services.

tip: urban chỉ thành thị, rural chỉ nông thôn.

senses.zh: phát thanh viên; người dẫn chương trình trực tiếp
senses.en: Someone who presents information on broadcasts or at public events

ex.en: The announcer reminded passengers to keep their bags nearby.
A skilled announcer can make emergency broadcasts clearer, helping the public respond calmly and appropriately.

col: television announcer｜phát thanh viên truyền hình
stadium announcer｜người thông báo tại sân vận động
tip: announcer phụ trách thông báo; journalist thiên về phỏng vấn, đưa tin.

senses.en: to make something flat or become flat
to destroy something so that it falls to the ground

ex.en: Flatten the dough gently with the palm of your hand.
Developers sometimes flatten existing buildings rather than renovate them, increasing construction waste and destroying local heritage.

col: flatten a building｜san phẳng tòa nhà
tip: flatten out cũng có thể chỉ giá cả hoặc đường cong dần ổn định.

senses.zh: hóa đơn; bản kê thanh toán
senses.en: a document listing goods or services and the payment required
to send someone a document requesting payment for goods or services

ex.en: The plumber emailed an invoice after fixing our sink.
Small businesses benefit from digital systems that track each invoice and remind customers when payments are due.

col: pay an invoice｜thanh toán hóa đơn
an outstanding invoice｜hóa đơn chưa thanh toán
invoice someone for something｜xuất hóa đơn cho ai về khoản nào đó
tip: invoice dùng để yêu cầu thanh toán; receipt là biên lai đã thanh toán.

senses.en: Money awarded to help someone pay for their studies.
Serious academic study or the knowledge gained through it.

ex.en: A scholarship helped Ravi pay for his university course.
Universities should offer more scholarships to talented applicants from families with limited financial resources.

tip: Khi chỉ học bổng thì đếm được; khi chỉ học thuật hoặc học vấn thì không đếm được.

senses.zh: phương tiện truyền thông; truyền thông
senses.en: Organisations and channels that provide news and information publicly.

ex.en: The local media reported on our neighbourhood festival.
The media can influence public attitudes by deciding which environmental issues receive the most attention.

col: media coverage｜đưa tin trên truyền thông
tip: Nói chung về truyền thông tin tức thường dùng the media; một phương tiện riêng lẻ là medium.

senses.en: an officer responsible for directing a military unit or operation

ex.en: The commander asked the crew to check their equipment.
During disaster relief operations, the military commander coordinated transport to deliver essential supplies to isolated communities.

tip: Chỉ người chỉ huy nói chung; khi là quân hàm cụ thể thì cấp bậc khác nhau theo từng nước.

senses.zh: cơn thịnh nộ; sự giận dữ
senses.en: An extremely strong feeling of anger.

senses.zh: sự dữ dội; sự hung bạo
senses.en: Extreme force or violence, especially in weather.

ex.en: He shook with fury when he discovered the damage.
The sudden closure of the local hospital provoked fury among residents who depended on its services.

col: shake with fury｜giận đến run người
provoke fury｜khơi dậy cơn thịnh nộ
the fury of the storm｜sự dữ dội của cơn bão
tip: Mạnh hơn anger; in a fury nghĩa là nổi cơn thịnh nộ.

senses.en: Easy to carry or move from place to place

ex.en: We took a portable speaker to the picnic.
Portable medical equipment enables healthcare workers to provide essential services in remote rural communities.

col: portable charger｜sạc dự phòng di động
tip: Nhấn mạnh dễ mang theo hoặc di chuyển, không nhất thiết bỏ vừa túi.

senses.en: the period when a king or queen rules
to rule as a king or queen
to be the strongest or most noticeable condition

ex.en: This castle was built during a young queen's reign.
During the king's reign, investment in public libraries made education more accessible to ordinary citizens.

col: during the reign of｜dưới triều đại của ...
a long reign｜thời kỳ trị vì lâu dài
tip: Đồng âm với rain; reign là sự trị vì, rein là dây cương.

senses.en: A dark mark caused by bleeding under the skin.
To injure skin or fruit without breaking its surface.

ex.en: I have a purple bruise on my knee.
Soft fruit can bruise during transport, so producers need packaging that provides adequate protection.

col: a bruised knee｜đầu gối bầm tím
tip: bruise thường không rách da; cut là vết đứt rách da.

senses.zh: yếu tố làm phức tạp; rắc rối
senses.en: An extra problem that makes a situation harder to manage
An additional medical problem arising during an illness or treatment

ex.en: A delayed train added another complication to our journey.
Regular medical checkups can help detect complications early and improve outcomes for patients with chronic conditions.

col: an unexpected complication｜rắc rối bất ngờ
a serious complication｜biến chứng nghiêm trọng
avoid complications｜tránh rắc rối hoặc biến chứng
postoperative complications｜biến chứng sau phẫu thuật
tip: Có thể chỉ rắc rối bổ sung hoặc biến chứng do bệnh hay điều trị gây ra.

senses.en: the foot of an animal such as a cat or dog
to scratch or touch something repeatedly with a paw or hoof

ex.en: The puppy rested one muddy paw on my knee.
Urban wildlife may suffer paw injuries from broken glass and other waste left in public spaces.

col: paw at the door｜cào cửa bằng chân
tip: paw chỉ cả bàn chân; claw là móng vuốt nhọn.

senses.en: to push a finger or pointed object into something
to move or stick out through an opening
a quick push with a finger or pointed object

ex.en: She poked the dough gently to check its softness.
Museum visitors can poke virtual objects on interactive screens to explore scientific concepts through play.

col: poke your head out｜thò đầu ra
tip: poke fun at nghĩa là chế giễu, không phải “chọc”.

senses.en: to remove or separate something from what it is attached to

senses.zh: tách mình ra; thoát khỏi ảnh hưởng
senses.en: to separate yourself emotionally from a situation or experience

ex.en: You can detach the hood when the rain stops.
Researchers must detach themselves from personal preferences when evaluating evidence to ensure that their conclusions remain reliable.

col: detach the cable｜rút dây kết nối
tip: Thường dùng detach A from B; detachable nghĩa là có thể tháo rời.

senses.en: a race in which teammates take turns completing sections
to pass information or broadcast signals to another person or place
an electrical switch controlled by another electrical circuit

ex.en: Our team dropped the baton during the school relay.
Emergency services relay weather warnings to remote communities through local radio stations and mobile networks.

tip: Động từ cũng đọc /rɪˈleɪ/; relay a message nghĩa là chuyển lời nhắn.

senses.en: A unit of inherited information that influences an organism's characteristics

ex.en: This gene can influence the colour of a cat's fur.
Identifying a gene linked to an inherited disease may help researchers develop more effective treatments.

col: inherit a gene｜thừa hưởng một gen
tip: gene là danh từ đếm được; genetics là di truyền học.

senses.zh: nhìn chằm chằm; nhìn chăm chú
senses.en: to look at someone or something steadily for a while
a long, fixed look at someone or something

ex.en: The cat stared at a bird outside the window.
Children who stare at screens for long periods may have fewer opportunities for physical activity.

col: a blank stare｜ánh mắt thẫn thờ
tip: stare at nhấn mạnh nhìn lâu; glance at là liếc nhìn.

senses.en: all human beings considered as one group

ex.en: This museum explores how mankind learned to grow food.
Climate change presents a challenge to mankind that requires sustained cooperation across national borders.

col: the future of mankind｜tương lai của nhân loại
the history of mankind｜lịch sử nhân loại
for the benefit of mankind｜vì lợi ích của nhân loại
tip: Chỉ toàn thể loài người, không chỉ nam giới; cách nói bao hàm hơn là humankind.

senses.en: Moving or shaped in a smooth, attractive way.

ex.en: The swan made a graceful turn across the pond.
The bridge combines graceful curves with practical engineering, creating an attractive landmark for the city.

col: a graceful dancer｜vũ công có dáng múa duyên dáng
tip: graceful thường tả dáng điệu đẹp; gracious thường chỉ sự tử tế, lịch sự.

senses.en: with careful attention to details or changes
with a strong connection or much cooperation
with little space between people or things

ex.en: Look closely at this leaf and notice its tiny veins.
Governments should closely monitor air quality near schools to protect children from the harmful effects of pollution.

col: work closely with｜hợp tác chặt chẽ với
tip: look closely là nhìn kỹ; stand close là đứng gần.

senses.en: a mathematical rule expressed using symbols

senses.zh: phương pháp; công thức pha chế
senses.en: a particular method or mixture used to achieve something

senses.zh: sữa công thức cho trẻ sơ sinh
senses.en: specially prepared milk used to feed babies

ex.en: Our teacher showed us a formula for calculating area.
There is no single formula for reducing urban poverty, since local economic conditions vary considerably.

col: formula for success｜công thức thành công
infant formula｜sữa công thức cho trẻ
tip: Số nhiều có thể là formulas hoặc formulae; “phương pháp” thường đi với for.

senses.en: Not fair, sensible, or willing to accept good reasons.
Greater than is fair or acceptable.

ex.en: It seems unreasonable to blame you for the weather.
Expecting employees to answer messages throughout their holidays places unreasonable demands on their time and harms wellbeing.

tip: Có thể tả người không biết điều, cũng có thể tả yêu cầu hoặc giá cả quá mức.

senses.en: a building or machine where grain is ground into flour
a factory that processes materials such as paper or steel
to crush grain or other material into small particles

ex.en: We watched wheat being ground at the old mill.
Converting abandoned textile mills into housing can preserve industrial heritage while meeting demand for urban accommodation.

col: flour mill｜nhà máy bột; cối xay
tip: mill thường chỉ nhà máy chế biến nguyên liệu; nhà máy thông thường dùng factory.

senses.en: So great or strong that little can oppose it
Too intense or difficult to deal with

ex.en: The proposal received overwhelming support from our neighbours.
An overwhelming majority of residents support investment in reliable public transport rather than wider roads.

col: overwhelming support｜sự ủng hộ áp đảo
overwhelming pressure｜áp lực quá sức chịu đựng
tip: Nhấn mạnh mức độ rất lớn; có thể tả sự ủng hộ hoặc áp lực.

senses.en: A senior government official responsible for a particular area.
A religious leader in certain Christian churches.
To care for someone or attend to their needs.

ex.en: The minister visited our school to meet the teachers.
Trained volunteers minister to the needs of older residents who lack access to regular medical care.

col: a church minister｜mục sư nhà thờ
minister to someone's needs｜chăm lo nhu cầu của ai
tip: Nghĩa động từ khá trang trọng, thường dùng minister to để chỉ chăm sóc.

senses.zh: có hiệu lực; được công nhận
senses.en: officially acceptable and able to be used
based on sound reasons or evidence

ex.en: Your ticket is still valid for the return journey.
Although online learning offers flexibility, students have valid concerns about limited interaction with their teachers.

col: valid for｜có hiệu lực trong; áp dụng cho
valid concern｜mối lo ngại có cơ sở
tip: valid for đi với khoảng thời gian có hiệu lực; valid until đi với thời điểm hết hạn.

senses.en: To officially forbid an action through rules or laws.

senses.zh: ngăn cản; làm cho không thể
senses.en: To prevent something by making it impossible or impractical.

ex.en: The pool rules prohibit running on the wet floor.
Governments should prohibit the dumping of untreated industrial waste into rivers to protect public health.

col: prohibit someone from doing something｜cấm ai làm gì
prohibit the use of｜cấm sử dụng
tip: Dùng prohibit doing hoặc prohibit sb from doing.

senses.en: a soft sea animal with hanging tentacles that can sting

ex.en: A translucent jellyfish drifted past our boat this morning.
Rising ocean temperatures may encourage jellyfish populations to grow, potentially disrupting marine ecosystems and coastal tourism.

col: a jellyfish sting｜vết đốt của sứa
a swarm of jellyfish｜một đàn sứa lớn
tip: Số nhiều thường vẫn là jellyfish; nó không phải loài cá.

senses.en: An extraordinary event that seems impossible or beyond natural explanation.

ex.en: It was a miracle that the vase survived.
Although new technology can appear to work miracles, lasting environmental progress also requires changes in public behaviour.

col: a medical miracle｜điều kỳ diệu của y học
a miracle cure｜phương thuốc thần kỳ
tip: work miracles nghĩa là tạo ra phép màu, cũng có thể nói phóng đại về hiệu quả kinh ngạc.

senses.en: to start an organisation, system, or lasting arrangement
to make a position or reputation widely accepted
to discover or prove that something is true

ex.en: Our neighbours established a gardening club last spring.
Governments should establish clear standards to ensure that new housing is both safe and energy efficient.

col: establish a business｜thành lập doanh nghiệp
establish a reputation｜gây dựng danh tiếng
establish the facts｜xác minh sự thật
establish a link｜thiết lập mối liên hệ
tip: establish là ngoại động từ, theo sau là cơ quan, chế độ, sự thật, v.v.

senses.zh: các tiêu chí; tiêu chuẩn (số nhiều)
senses.en: Standards used to judge something or make a decision.

ex.en: This flat meets all our criteria for a home.
Scholarships should be awarded according to clear criteria that consider both academic achievement and financial need.

col: meet the criteria｜đáp ứng tiêu chí
tip: criteria là số nhiều, số ít là criterion; dùng criteria are.

senses.en: To communicate or do things with other people.
To affect one another when combined or brought together.

ex.en: Our neighbours often interact while their children play outside.
Group projects encourage students to interact with classmates whose experiences and perspectives differ from their own.

col: interact with each other｜giao tiếp lẫn nhau
tip: Nội động từ: tương tác với ai dùng interact with someone.

senses.en: believing certain actions or objects bring good or bad luck

ex.en: My superstitious cousin always carries a lucky stone.
Superstitious beliefs may influence financial decisions when people rely on lucky objects rather than reliable evidence.

tip: Thường dùng be superstitious about, nghĩa là mê tín về điều gì.

senses.en: A national body of representatives that makes laws.

senses.zh: đại hội; hội nghị chuyên đề
senses.en: A large formal meeting of representatives or specialists.

ex.en: The congress debated the new law late into the night.
Delegates at the international congress discussed practical ways to improve access to healthcare in rural communities.

col: a national congress｜đại hội toàn quốc
an international congress｜đại hội quốc tế
a member of Congress｜nghị sĩ quốc hội
tip: Khi chỉ Quốc hội Mỹ hoặc cơ quan tương tự thì thường viết hoa Congress.

senses.zh: sự hoảng loạn; nỗi kinh hoàng
senses.en: sudden strong fear that makes clear thinking difficult
to feel or cause sudden fear and lose calm

ex.en: I felt a moment of panic when my keys disappeared.
Clear communication during emergencies can reduce public panic and help people follow safety instructions more effectively.

tip: Quá khứ panicked, hiện tại phân từ panicking đều phải thêm k sau c.

senses.en: Powder mixed with water to bind building materials together.
To make a relationship or agreement stronger.

ex.en: The builder mixed cement and water in a bucket.
Joint research projects can cement relationships between universities and encourage the exchange of scientific knowledge.

col: a bag of cement｜một bao xi măng
cement a relationship｜củng cố mối quan hệ
tip: cement là xi măng; concrete là bê tông gồm xi măng, cát, đá.

senses.en: Very bad, intense, or damaging.
Very strict or harsh in treatment or judgment.

ex.en: Severe storms knocked down several trees near our house.
Severe water shortages can undermine agricultural production, forcing governments to invest in more efficient irrigation systems.

col: a severe shortage｜thiếu hụt nghiêm trọng
tip: Có thể bổ nghĩa cho cơn đau, thời tiết, sự thiếu hụt hoặc hình phạt để chỉ mức độ nặng.

senses.en: The purpose or job of something or someone.
To work or operate in the intended way.
A mathematical relationship assigning each input exactly one output.

ex.en: What is the function of this small red button?
Urban parks serve an important function by providing space for exercise, relaxation, and social interaction.

col: perform a function｜phát huy tác dụng
tip: function as theo sau là danh từ, nghĩa là đóng vai trò là.

senses.en: Probably true, based on what is known or reasonably expected.

ex.en: Her coat is gone, so presumably she has left.
More frequent bus services would presumably encourage commuters to leave their cars at home, reducing urban traffic.

col: presumably intended to｜có lẽ là để
presumably true｜theo phỏng đoán là đúng
tip: Diễn tả phỏng đoán có căn cứ, không mang sắc thái chắc chắn như certainly.
